create_wikipedia_dataset: create a wikipedia json_dataset instance that loads wikidump_lines.json with text_key set to text
create_webtext_dataset: create a webtext json_dataset instance that loads data.json with text_key set to text
use_named_corpora_lookup: use the NAMED_CORPORA dictionary to look up wikipedia or webtext dataset classes by string key
review_wikipedia_class: review the wikipedia class which extends json_dataset with preset PATH and loose_json arguments
review_webtext_class: review the webtext class which extends json_dataset with preset PATH and loose_json arguments
